item.title: Kukie Serving.07 API Gateway and Connector
item.description: How one public Kukie API address reaches models on customers’ own GPU clusters — Kotlin keeps accounts, permissions, keys and usage, a Go gateway relays JSON/SSE without storing bodies, and a connector inside each customer cluster dials out over WebSocket; plus the load test that moved key checks off the request path (member CPU 0.67 to 0.02 cores, ITL p95 72.5 to 29.3ms) and a 31-hour outage caused by credential re-issue.
